model_annotation: This chart displays the number of instances and accuracy rates for five different sub-question types across both training and validation sets. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled "实体识别" (Entity Recognition), "角色识别" (Role Recognition), "异常识别" (Anomaly Recognition), "空间推理" (Spatial Reasoning), and "同义识别" (Synonym Recognition), in that order. The vertical axis on the left side represents the count of instances, with values ranging from 0 to 1200 in increments of 200, while the vertical axis on the right side denotes the accuracy rate, spanning from 0 to 1 in increments of 0.1. The chart features blue bars indicating the number of instances in the training set and orange bars representing the count in the validation set, accompanied by a gray line illustrating the accuracy rate for each category. The counts for the training set are approximately 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 250, corresponding to the categories listed, while the validation set counts are around 40, 190, 675, 5, and 55, respectively. The accuracy rates, as shown by the gray line, are roughly 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.2852, and 0.3769 for the respective categories. The categories are presented in the order they appear on the horizontal axis, without any specific sorting by count or accuracy rate, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular category.
